Controls.Intro: Make the controls yours. Click a binding, then press the key or mouse button you want.
Controls.How_to_bind: Click a slot and press an input. Hold Shift, Ctrl or Alt first to assign a combination, e.g. Left Shift + Mouse1 in the mouse slot. Use × to clear a slot.
Controls.Capture_keyboard: Click to assign a keyboard key
Controls.Capture_mouse: Click to assign a mouse button
Controls.Preset_hint: Dark Souls 3: middle-click to lock on, wheel down to cycle items. Adapted for Bloodborne. Save settings to keep changes.
Controls.Modifier_hint: Each slot can hold a key or a combination. Keyboard and mouse slots are alternatives. The most specific matching combination takes priority over a simpler binding of the same input. Strong attack modifier + Attack still works.
Controls.Capture_hint: Hold left/right Shift, Ctrl or Alt, then press the input for this slot. To assign a modifier alone, press and release it in the keyboard slot. Esc cancels. Choose Save settings to keep changes.
Controls.Holding_key: Holding {0}. Press another key, or release a modifier to assign it.
Controls.Holding_mouse: Holding {0}. Press a mouse button or turn the wheel.
Controls.Wait_mouse: Press a mouse button or turn the wheel…
Controls.Unsupported: This key cannot be assigned. Choose another key, or press Esc to cancel.
Controls.Shared: Shared inputs: {0}. These actions will respond together.
Controls.Save_hint: Changes are kept when you choose Save settings. Custom remembers your own bindings.
Controls.Custom_hint: Your custom bindings are kept when you switch presets. Save settings to keep them for the next launch.

Hub.Home_description: Your game, your setup. Everything in one place.
Hub.Display_description: Output resolution, frame rate and presentation.
Hub.Graphics_description: A clear picture. A smoother hunt. Set the balance that feels right.
Hub.Profile_scope: Profiles store display, graphics, camera and input settings. Installation paths, language and online accounts stay shared.
Hub.Render_scale_hint: Preview of the requested resolution. Runtime alignment or compatibility can change the actual scene size. HUD and menus stay at output resolution.
Hub.Keycap_hint: Select a key here or any binding in the table to reassign it.
Hub.Chord_hint: Hold Shift, Ctrl or Alt to assign a combination such as Shift + Mouse1.
Hub.Controller_hint: Choose the active controller below. Keyboard and mouse bindings remain independent. Controller button remapping is not available here.

Saves.Title: Saves & mods
Saves.Description: Keep local save backups and manage your mods.
Saves.Safety: Close the game before backup or restore. Restoring replaces only the selected title and user, including its metadata. Techmo creates a safety backup first. Import accepts Techmo backup ZIP files.
Hdr.Description: Uses native scene HDR by default. Enable highlight expansion to derive HDR from the final SDR image instead. Verify brightness on your display.
Hdr.Requirements: Enable Windows HDR on an HDR10 display before starting the game. If Vulkan does not expose HDR10 output, Techmo keeps SDR and logs the reason. HDR is evaluated when the game starts.
Hdr.Shared: Display calibration is shared across profiles. Apply changes, then restart the game. Leave highlight expansion off to use the native scene path.
Saves.Message_2: Close the game before backing up or restoring save data.
Saves.Message_3: No save data found in this launcher’s user folder.
Saves.Message_9: Restore {0} for user {1}? This replaces that save set. A safety backup of the current data is created first.
Saves.Message_16: Wait for the save operation to finish.
Saves.Message_17: No usable save data, or the backup limit was exceeded.
Saves.Message_18: The backup failed its integrity check.
Saves.Message_19: This is not a supported Techmo save backup.
Saves.Message_22: Missing, duplicate or invalid backup entry.
Saves.Message_23: The backup contains no game save files.
Saves.Message_25: Invalid save user or title ID.
Saves.Message_26: The archive contains an unsafe path.
Saves.Message_28: Save operations do not follow symbolic links or junctions.
Saves.Message_30: Save data changed or exceeded its declared size.
Saves.Message_31: Save data changed or the backup is truncated.
Lighting.Title: Lighting & color
Lighting.Description: Adjust each effect independently. 100% preserves the original settings for each area.
Lighting.Restore_hint: Reset only lighting and color to 100%, with vignette enabled.
Lighting.Restart: Apply changes, then restart the game.
Lighting.Ao_hint: Requires SSAO to be enabled. 0% removes ambient occlusion.
Lighting.Shadow_hint: Requires dynamic shadows to be enabled. 100% keeps the original shadow distance.
Lighting.Slider_help: Drag to adjust by 1%. Arrow keys adjust by 1%; Page Up/Down by 10%.
Lighting.Bloom_hint: 0% disables bloom. 100% preserves the original glow.
Lighting.Saturation_hint: 0% is grayscale. 100% preserves the original colors.
Sharpening.Description: Adjust image sharpness. High values can emphasize noise and bright edges. Apply changes, then restart the game.
Sharpening.Off: Sharpening is unavailable with Upscaler Off. Your strength is kept for TAA, DLSS or FSR.
Sharpening.Help: Range 0–2. Arrow keys adjust by 0.01; Page Up/Down by 0.10. Default: 0.30.
Mods.Title: Mod manager
Mods.Apply_hint: Toggle mods or change their order, then Apply changes. Changes take effect on the next game start.
Mods.Order_hint: Lower mods take priority when files overlap. Select a folder mod to move it. Legacy and root overlays load first and keep their positions.
Mods.Install_hint: Extract each mod into mods/<name>/dvdroot_ps4/… (chr/, parts/, etc. are also accepted). Then Refresh. ZIP/RAR/7z and DLL injectors are not loaded here; XML patches use the separate patch system.
Mods.Archive: Extract this archive into a mod folder first
Mods.Type: This file type is not a loose-file mod
Mods.Direct: Loose files at the mods root
Mods.No_mods: No mods found. Extract each mod into its own folder, then Refresh.
Mods.Scan_complete: Folder scan complete. File lists do not verify gameplay compatibility.
Mods.No_conflicts: No shared files among enabled mods.
Mods.Conflicts: {0} shared file(s). The lower mod wins; the list shows up to 200 files.
Mods.Disabled: Mods are disabled for the next launch.
Mods.Config_error: Mod configuration could not be read and was preserved: {0}
Mods.Fix_config: Fix mods.json or turn off mods before applying.
Overlay.Title: In-game overlay
Hub.Undo_hint: Discard all unapplied edits and restore the last applied settings.
Overlay.VramDescription: Game process local GPU memory / physical dedicated VRAM on the card rendering the game. Shared system RAM is excluded.
Overlay.Description: Choose which stats appear together in the corner. CPU shows overall system load; GPU shows usage of the card running the game. Samples update about twice per second. N/A means the counter is unavailable.
Benchmark.Title: Benchmark
Benchmark.Description: Record FPS, frame times and process memory for a manual gameplay run. Start the collector, load your test location, then confirm recording in its window.
Recommend.Title: Recommended graphics
Recommend.Description: Suggest upscaling, resolution and frame rate for this PC. Review the changes before selecting them.
Recommend.Matched: Your current settings already match the recommendation for this PC.
Recommend.Explanation: Based on your hardware, not a benchmark. Only the listed settings will change. Use Apply in the launcher to save; Undo discards them.
Recommend.Staged: Recommendation selected. Use Apply to save or Undo to discard.
Trophies.Description: Track all 40 trophies, completion and in-game notifications.
Engine.Description: Tune the engine switches. Defaults remain in effect until you change them.
